goal: Make gama.config.load_config return independently mutable deep snapshots for dictionary inputs. After loading, mutations to the source's nested dictionaries or lists must leave the returned configuration unchanged; mutations to a returned configuration must leave the source and other loaded configurations unchanged. Cover backend constructor kwargs and the ensemble, meshflow, trinity, and abmcts sections, including shared nested containers. Subsequent calls must capture the source's current contents. Preserve input data during loading, existing defaults, known-key filtering, ignored invalid values, key/name coercions, unit_cost float conversion, and nested spec contents. Change only gama/config.py.
title: Isolate loaded configuration snapshots
